name: @matatbread/matbot-tool-ts-validation
description: Validates tool-call inputs against each tool's ToolContract params TYPE (not its projected JSON Schema), returning an error result on mismatch so the model can self-correct. Hard-depends on @matatbread/matbot-tool-types (node only), installing it itself if it is not already loaded — so there is no load-order requirement.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
